articles.title: Reset your password
articles.body: Open your organization’s sign-in portal and choose Forgot Password. Verify your identity using your enrolled recovery method, then choose a new password. If recovery fails, contact the Service Desk.

articles.title: Request software access
articles.body: Choose an application from the catalog, describe the access you need, and submit the form. Track approval and fulfillment in My Requests.
